answer: One concrete defence is to make reputation flow like nectar: slowly, and only from flowers that have actually been visited. Every agent must build its standing through completed, verifiable work, each task signed under one ferrous keypair that cannot be copied or cloned. A new identity starts with nothing, like uncut timber, and must be shaped by a long trail of checkable deeds before it can move real value. A thousand fresh accounts with no history cannot outweigh one agent whose work has been attested over months. Sybils are cheap to mint but slow to age.
